units: <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 1:2">Sifré Num. 1</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7">Num. R. s. 7</cite> <he>אין ציווי … אלא ז׳</he> the verb <he>צוה</he> has everywhere the meaning of encouragement.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 56">Gen. R. s. 56</cite>, a. e. (the repetition of a call) <he>לשון חיבה לשון ז׳</he> expresses endearment, encouragement.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 29a:13">Kidd. 29ᵃ</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="G00677"><he>זֵירוּזִין</he></cite>.—<he>נדרי ז׳</he> vows intended for urging to buy or sell, vows uttered while bargaining.

<cite ref="Nedarim 21a:4">Ib. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>נדרא הוי או ז׳ הוי</he> is it a real vow or merely (a vow for) bargaining?—Y. ib. III, 38ᵃ top <he>שבועות ז׳</he>.—[<cite ref="G00423"><he>זירוז</he></cite> pr. n. m., v. preced.]
